g.text: 2 · Does the model pick the better biostimulant?

text.style: font-size: 7px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #6b7280

g.text: Fruit yield, TRAIN, out-of-fold; arms vs the same control: 49 studies / 911 pairs (15 / 280 across classes)

text.style: font-size: 5.6px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #6b7280

g.text: Choice = arm with the highest predicted lnRR. Decisive pairs: |observed difference| > 1.96 SE (control cancels). Noise-aware accuracy weights each pair by

text.style: font-size: 5.6px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #6b7280

g.text: P(observed order is true). Regret < 0 = less yield lost than a random pick. Study-balanced means, 2000 study bootstrap resamples. RF was not the pre-selected

text.style: font-size: 5.6px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #6b7280

g.text: model (exploratory). A simple class prior performs as well as the ML models.
